articles.title: Pakistan: President puts Khan stronghold province under emergency rule

events.summary: Pakistani President Asif Ali Zardari has imposed emergency rule on Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, effectively suspending its provincial government. The northwestern province is a key political stronghold run by former Prime Minister Imran Khan's PTI party.
events.why: It marks a significant constitutional and political escalation that disenfranchises an elected provincial government and risks widespread unrest.

articles.title: A migrant boat sank off the coast of Djibouti with the UN reporting over 200 people dead or missing

events.summary: A migrant boat sank off the coast of Djibouti en route to Yemen, leaving at least 139 people confirmed dead and 84 missing. According to the UN migration agency, 15 children died and at least 80 Ethiopians survived.
events.why: It involves a catastrophic loss of human life along a major irregular migration corridor.

articles.title: Germany rejects Trump demand, 'fully supports' Zelenskyy

events.summary: Germany's foreign minister reaffirmed full support for Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, rejecting demands from Donald Trump. Separately, the CEO of Deutsche Bank warned that rising political extremism is deterring investors.
events.why: It demonstrates continued European diplomatic and strategic divergence from US political rhetoric regarding the war in Ukraine.
